label: 샷건
description: 올리브색 몸통, 황토색 펌프·개머리판, 어두운 총구와 주황 가늠쇠. 측면을 충분히 보여 펌프와 길이를 읽히게 함. (the olive green shotgun with ochre pump and stock from the reference, shown mostly from the side)
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production inventory item icon for Train Survival, continuing the supplied existing icon set. Isolated on genuinely transparent RGBA background, square canvas at least 1024px. Entire object centered, longest extent 80% of canvas, minimum 8% padding every edge.
STYLE: hand-painted semi-cartoon, chunky rounded low-poly-inspired shapes, broad restrained color planes, matte surfaces, soft upper-left form shading, restrained dark contour separation. Readable at 32/48/56px. No photographic texture, tiny scratches, excessive detail or glossy specular. Match the supplied Wood icon's rendering style; don't copy its subject, wood, logs or rope unless requested.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the ACTUAL MODEL SUBJECT reference. Preserve its identity, proportions, parts, painted color blocks; ignore background and raw render lighting. Image 2 is Wood STYLE ONLY.
SUBJECT Shotgun (샷건): 올리브색 몸통, 황토색 펌프·개머리판, 어두운 총구와 주황 가늠쇠. 측면을 충분히 보여 펌프와 길이를 읽히게 함. (the olive green shotgun with ochre pump and stock from the reference, shown mostly from the side)
COMPOSITION: weak-perspective three-quarter view; clothing nearly front view with empty interiors and no mannequin. Long tools grip lower-left, functional end upper-right; do not mirror actual model. Food viewed slightly from above so contents read.
No text, numbers, UI slots/frames/badges, extra objects, hands, people, mannequins, backgrounds, ground, cast shadow, steam, particles, external glow or watermark. A single cohesive collectible; paired boots or specified clusters count as one item.
